summary:
Reviewed detached snapshot d43b2b6f8cf60026f0d49ef4ef2b36aab9f2ef80 and the fd9fd84 diff. All 142 embedded packet files match the worktree byte-for-byte. R15-B01 and R15-B02 are resolved. One newly identified S0 remains: the grammar and an existing test reject the explicitly defaulted omission of schedule expansion. The same required field exists at fd9fd84, so this is a newly found pre-existing defect, not a regression caused by the R15 fixes.

Required method (1): derived inc8(255) at B=0/2/3/4 as (0,1,0)/(0,1,2)/(0,0,3)/(0,0,3); derived udiv(7,0), B=1 as (0,5,1), and sdiv(128,255), B=1 as (0,6,1). All CLI results agree. Reconstructed/checked the literal §16.3 261-byte LF-terminated inc8 envelope, SHA-256 8ce5e64f15830d8e596ba9b4861def6565dd567b5804300f427d8b9566d5be93; no references means closure=interface. Removing the schedule/certificate and its boundary LF independently gives 8093da48bad04d6564325faf01ea1304a84b5ac5a120e685eee9951f5daec5d9. Both copied R15 witness file hashes match their published pins.

Method (2): traced a complete add inverse: restore old pc via the two exchanges, cancel successor, exchange r with its saved assignment slot, then XOR the old-state x+one into that slot; pc_prime and the frame clear. Traced mixed call inverse C5 through C1 and return inverse R5 through R1 against §3.7, checking restored sp/fp before address/condition evaluation. Exhaustive inc8 step-check passes 256 inputs at B=3; the separately rerun recursive every-prefix sweep passes. Traced the nested/f/g call-ret-uncall segments through classical.rs::undo_frame/undo_record: restore clock and overwritten bytes, retire the effect tape entry, skip previously reversed inner frames and uncall markers. CLI reverse nested restores the complete entry snapshot and memory digest.

Method (3): revisited SPEC-QUESTIONS 1–32 against their cited clauses, including metadata encodings, decimal/integer representations, tuple conventions, qif lifetime order, measurement order, the dotted-path limitation and address namespace. The two R15 repairs need no new reading. No recorded reading covers expansion omission. The explicit §17 default determines R16-B01 despite §11’s schematic field list.

Method (4): searched production Rust and crate text for todo!, unimplemented!, unwrap/expect/panic/unreachable, unsupported and approximation/assumption markers. Classified the production hits as validated container/type invariants, graph/history invariants, explicit unsupported-device diagnostics or approximate display routines alongside exact decisions; test hits are assertions/fixture constructors. Inspected the borrow-history unwrap guards, epoch-rank construction, running-control guard, exact-number conversion and schema-reference invariant. No new panic or silent-fallback witness was established. Staged Unverified claims remain distinct from successful verification.

Method (5): revisited §4.1–§4.8 row/opcode families, §5.4 faults, §3.6–§3.7 frame/slot forms, §7.4 history forms, metadata field/alternative coverage, CLI dispatch and suite obligations. The table has 163 productions: scalar leaves, signatures and memory slots, object sections, schedule paths/selectors/payloads, all five claim kinds and three structural rules, domains, expected tuples, expressions, frames, composition and coverage. The new translation tuple is correct. Cross-checking defaults in §17 revealed the expansion optionality defect; generated grammar tests alone cannot detect a wrong required-field declaration. No additional execution/reversal defect was established. The reread concentrated on the changed grammar/semantic boundary and reachable admission, dispatch and reversal paths; passing tests is not a proof of every ISA behavior.

Observed validation: focused R15 tests 5 passed; normal cargo test --offline --no-fail-fast 384 passed/0 failed/5 ignored. Schema family: 163/9806/1653/26545/1992/26/2393/17173, totaling 43718 negative cases without recounting dual-admission assertions. Width family: 507 cases, 159 constructed, 286 layout rejections, 62 resource diagnostics. Separately ran exhaustive_recursive_prefixes: 1 passed/0 failed, 256 inputs across every prefix through completion/first fault. The other four ignored sweeps were not rerun here; their editor-recorded successful runs remain historical evidence. Independently exercised 22 CLI assertions covering frame lengths and decimal zero/nonzero controls; all match the R15 fixes. Reproduced R16-B01 under both check and hash and saved the exact witness. Commands used the requested headless environment and offline cargo manifest. No tracked files were modified; no commit or push was made.
